candidates.tagline: Memphis built a bike lane. Drivers saw a parking spot.
candidates.story: Memphis resurfaced North Parkway and installed new bike lanes on Nov 10, 2026, but the stripe design is immediately confusing — the two solid white lines marking parking spaces look like an extra-wide bike lane, signs are tiny, and cars were caught parked in the new bike lane within days.
candidates.why_funny: The entire point of a bike lane is to be unmistakably clear, and this one confused drivers and cyclists before the paint was dry.
candidates.alt: Wide suburban road on North Parkway, Memphis, showing newly painted white lane markings with an orange traffic cone visible in the distance; TV chyron reads 'New Bike Lanes on Busy Street'

candidates.tagline: They called it the new Sydney Opera House. Everyone else calls it the Milk Crate.
candidates.story: Sydney's $915M Powerhouse Parramatta museum opened November 7, 2026 — billed as Australia's biggest cultural investment since the Opera House — but critics immediately nicknamed its geometric steel lattice exterior the 'Milk Crate,' while its CEO stepped down under a misconduct investigation and key collection pieces (like a 240-year-old steam engine) remained in storage.
candidates.why_funny: A billion-dollar museum shaped like a crate, built in a flood zone, opened without its own exhibits or its own CEO — right on schedule.
candidates.alt: Two large white museum buildings with diamond-patterned steel lattice facades rising above Parramatta, Sydney, surrounded by trees and taller glass office towers
